en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, raising it, said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Defends, by the pigeons, the house from crumbling down’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad in a marfu‘ manner has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, with pigeons, keeps a house safe from crumbling down.’”
